query:
-- Insérer les liaisons pour Lavande (id à trouver)
INSERT INTO plant_molecules (plant_id, molecule_id, concentration, plant_part, extraction_method, notes)
SELECT p.id, m.id, 35.0, 'fleurs', 'HE', 'Composant principal de l''huile essentielle de lavande'
FROM plants p, molecules m
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Lavande%' AND m.name LIKE '%Linalol%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plant_molecules pm WHERE pm.plant_id = p.id AND pm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO plant_molecules (plant_id, molecule_id, concentration, plant_part, extraction_method, notes)
SELECT p.id, m.id, 5.0, 'fleurs', 'HE', 'Note camphrée caractéristique'
FROM plants p, molecules m
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Lavande%' AND m.name LIKE '%Camphre%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plant_molecules pm WHERE pm.plant_id = p.id AND pm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Menthe poivrée
INSERT INTO plant_molecules (plant_id, molecule_id, concentration, plant_part, extraction_method, notes)
SELECT p.id, m.id, 45.0, 'feuilles', 'HE', 'Composant principal donnant la fraîcheur caractéristique'
FROM plants p, molecules m
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Menthe%' AND m.name LIKE '%Menthol%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plant_molecules pm WHERE pm.plant_id = p.id AND pm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Eucalyptus
INSERT INTO plant_molecules (plant_id, molecule_id, concentration, plant_part, extraction_method, notes)
SELECT p.id, m.id, 70.0, 'feuilles', 'HE', 'Composant majoritaire de l''eucalyptus'
FROM plants p, molecules m
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Eucalyptus%' AND (m.name LIKE '%Cinéole%' OR m.name LIKE '%Cineole%')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plant_molecules pm WHERE pm.plant_id = p.id AND pm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Romarin
INSERT INTO plant_molecules (plant_id, molecule_id, concentration, plant_part, extraction_method, notes)
SELECT p.id, m.id, 40.0, 'feuilles', 'HE', 'Note fraîche et camphrée'
FROM plants p, molecules m
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Romarin%' AND (m.name LIKE '%Cinéole%' OR m.name LIKE '%Cineole%')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plant_molecules pm WHERE pm.plant_id = p.id AND pm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO plant_molecules (plant_id, molecule_id, concentration, plant_part, extraction_method, notes)
SELECT p.id, m.id, 15.0, 'feuilles', 'HE', 'Note camphrée caractéristique du romarin'
FROM plants p, molecules m
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Romarin%' AND m.name LIKE '%Camphre%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plant_molecules pm WHERE pm.plant_id = p.id AND pm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;
